event.notes: "name" is matched as a substring against ESPN's own event name (punctuation and case are ignored, but spelling is NOT — no typo tolerance here, unlike fighter-name matching elsewhere in the pipeline), and the FIRST match in the scoreboard window wins. ESPN spells the main-event surname "Rodrigues" (Gregory Rodrigues, Brazilian) rather than the more common "Rodriguez" — confirm against ESPN before a run if this ever looks wrong. A one-off Fight Night is unique inside the 45-day lookahead so a short name like this is enough; for a weekly series (e.g. Contender Series) the name needs season+week instead, see git history. Discovery pulls recent uploads from each capper channel and keeps the ones whose title matches settings.discovery.title_contains. Add entries to "videos" only to pin a specific video by hand.
